channel.title: GiveOwl – Black Friday competitions 2026 (UK)
channel.description: 7 UK Black Friday competitions are open for 2026; this page lists UK prize draws and competitions, not retail Black Friday sale deals; the next deadline is 27 November 2026 (BOOHOOMAN) and the last is 2 December 2026 (Flower & White).

item.title: BOOHOOMAN Black Friday £1K Cash Comp: win £1,000 cash – BOOHOOMAN (Boohoo.com UK Limited)
item.description: Prize: £1,000 cash (1 winner across all participating countries). Deadline: November 27, 2026. Fill in the entry form on the BOOHOOMAN Black Friday Countdown page with first name, last name, email and date of birth (mobile optional); you agree to BOOHOOMAN marketing emails. Free, no purchase. Open to 18+ residents of the UK, Ireland, the US, France, Germany, the Netherlands and Australia. 9 Nov (09:30 GMT) – 27 Nov 2026 23:59 GMT; one winner announced by email on 30 Nov 2026

item.title: Cartridge People Black Colourful Friday free daily prize draw – The Cartridge People Ltd
item.description: Prize: Seven daily prizes 23–29 Nov, incl. a Samsung Q7F 55" 4K TV, Shark Freestyle Max vacuum, Ninja coffee machine, Lenovo tablet, Cricut Explore 4 and Samsung Odyssey monitor + Brother scanner. Deadline: November 29, 2026. Free entry form on the Cartridge People Black Friday promotion page, once per day from 23 to 29 November 2026 (each day closes 23:59 GMT). No purchase necessary; orders also give an automatic entry. UK & Channel Islands residents 18+

item.title: Ordo Black Friday Airbnb Giveaway 2026 (UK) – Ordo (Ordoclub Ltd)
item.description: Prize: Six Airbnb gift cards: £1,500, 2 × £500 and 3 × £250 (total £3,250). Deadline: November 29, 2026. Enter via the online form with name and email or mobile; no purchase and no marketing opt-in required. UK residents 18+. 1 Nov 16:00 GMT to 29 Nov 2026 23:59 GMT

item.title: EcoFlow UK Black Friday Lucky Draw: win an EcoFlow STREAM power station or £200 gift cards – EcoFlow UK
item.description: Prize: Draw in three rounds; the remaining rounds (announced 27 and 30 November 2026) each have 1 EcoFlow STREAM system and 3 × £200 EcoFlow gift cards. Deadline: November 30, 2026. Subscribe to the EcoFlow Black Friday mailing list with your email on the EcoFlow UK Black Friday page. One entry per person/email. No purchase necessary. Open 2 November – 30 November 2026, 09:00 (UK time as stated in the rules)

item.title: iD Mobile Community Black Friday giveaway: win a 75" Hisense TV, Google Pixel 11, Nintendo Switch 2 and more – iD Mobile (Currys Group Limited)
item.description: Prize: Five prizes: 75" Hisense Q7S Hi-QLED 4K Smart AI TV (RRP £1,299), Google Pixel 11 (£879), Nintendo Switch 2 (£419), Shark CryoGlow LED face mask (£379) and Ninja CRISPi Dual Zone air fryer (£299). Deadline: November 30, 2026. Register (free) with the iD Mobile Community and answer the question in a comment on the Black Friday 2026 competition thread; one entry per person. UK residents (incl. Isle of Man) aged over 18. 4–30 November 2026, 23:59. No purchase necessary

item.title: Trygghetslagret Black Friday competition: win a gift card worth NOK 10,000 – Trygghetslagret
item.description: Prize: Gift card(s) worth NOK 10,000 in total (paid in the GBP equivalent at the Norges Bank rate on 2 Dec 2026) at a shop or service the winner chooses; one winner across Norway, Sweden and the UK. Deadline: November 30, 2026. Enter free without purchase by emailing your full name, country of residence and confirmation that you are 18+ and have read the terms to support@trygghetslagret.com with the subject «BF26» (English accepted). Buying an emergency radio or sleeping bag also enters you, with equal odds. No newsletter needed. One entry per person. 18+, resident in Norway, Sweden or the UK. UK: 19 Nov 23:00 – 30 Nov 2026 22:59 GMT; draw 2 December

item.title: Flower & White Black Friday VIP giveaway: £500 in vouchers – Flower & White
item.description: Prize: £250 Secret Escapes voucher + £250 Love2shop voucher (£500 total), one winner. Deadline: December 2, 2026. Join the Black Friday VIP list via the sign-up form on the page. Free, one entry per person, UK residents 18+. Winner drawn 2 December 2026; page says entries until 6 December 2026
